source.caption: Functional enrichment analysis based on CGs. A: Venn diagram illustrating the intersection of differentially expressed genes (DEGs) from the GSE57338 dataset, key module genes identified through WGCNA, and vascular aging-related biomarkers, resulting in the identification of CGs. B: Circular plot depicting the results of Gene Ontology (GO) enrichment analysis based on the CGs. This visualization highlights the biological processes, cellular components, and molecular functions enriched within the gene set. C: Bar chart presenting the outcomes of Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway enrichment analysis based on the CGs.
